bangkok/creative-renaissance-video.keyIdea: Bangkok creatives restore older buildings and mix traditional culture with new art rather than replacing everything.
bangkok/creative-renaissance-video.tradeoff: Making art welcoming takes work beyond simply saving an old building.
bangkok/creative-renaissance-video.designUse: Turn restored buildings into welcoming places for local creative work.

bangkok/food-identity-video.keyIdea: Bangkok's independent food shops help give the city a character that chain restaurants cannot easily replace.
bangkok/food-identity-video.tradeoff: Independent shops are disappearing, putting their distinctive food and local character at risk.
bangkok/food-identity-video.designUse: Reserve affordable space for independent cooks alongside larger food businesses.

bangkok/river-boats-video.keyIdea: At Sathorn Pier, Bangkok's boats connect river trips with trains, nearby hotels, and places to visit.
bangkok/river-boats-video.tradeoff: Different counters, flags, and waiting areas can make choosing the right boat confusing.
bangkok/river-boats-video.designUse: Match signs at shared stops to each service and waiting area.

bangkok/songkran-city-ritual.keyIdea: Bangkok's Songkran brings family and temple customs into streets shared by local people and visitors.
bangkok/songkran-city-ritual.tradeoff: A water-party image can hide the festival's family ties and deeper meanings.
bangkok/songkran-city-ritual.designUse: Explain a celebration's meaning alongside rules for sharing crowded streets.

bangkok/green-escape.keyIdea: Bangkok's Benjakitti Park turns former industrial land into green public space with water, walking routes, and shade.
bangkok/green-escape.tradeoff: Parks need valuable land and upkeep, reducing space available for short-term profit.
bangkok/green-escape.designUse: Keep useful land for free green spaces that manage heat and water.

bangkok/city-of-design.keyIdea: Bangkok treats design as a way to improve everyday streets, shops, and public spaces, not just luxury products.
bangkok/city-of-design.tradeoff: Beautiful or efficient designs may still create difficulties for other users.
bangkok/city-of-design.designUse: Ask ordinary users how redesigned spaces could make daily tasks easier.

tokyo/metro-economics-video.keyIdea: Tokyo connects commuter trains directly with subway tracks, reducing transfers, while shared payment cards simplify journeys.
tokyo/metro-economics-video.tradeoff: Distance-based fares mean people making longer journeys must pay more.
tokyo/metro-economics-video.designUse: Join rail routes and payment systems so passengers change less often.

tokyo/vending-machines-video.keyIdea: Tokyo's vending machines provide goods around the clock, and some reuse cooling heat to warm drinks.
tokyo/vending-machines-video.tradeoff: Operators still refill machines, while convenience stores compete for customers and locations.
tokyo/vending-machines-video.designUse: Reuse waste heat inside equipment that offers services throughout the day.

tokyo/urban-history-video.keyIdea: Tokyo's rebuilding after fires and earthquakes changed street layouts and expanded railways into new residential areas.
tokyo/urban-history-video.tradeoff: The changes followed disasters that destroyed homes and large parts of the city.
tokyo/urban-history-video.designUse: Use rebuilding plans to connect new homes with safe transport routes.

tokyo/earthquake-readiness.keyIdea: Tokyo protects emergency roads by strengthening nearby buildings, linking city rescue plans with everyday household preparation.
tokyo/earthquake-readiness.tradeoff: Dense housing, damaged services, and stranded commuters can still make disaster response difficult.
tokyo/earthquake-readiness.designUse: Protect rescue routes while helping households plan supplies and communication.

tokyo/harajuku-fashion.keyIdea: In Harajuku, young people mix different clothes and styles to show who they are in public.
tokyo/harajuku-fashion.tradeoff: Tourism and big brands can turn many personal styles into one simple image.
tokyo/harajuku-fashion.designUse: Leave public space for young people to display their own styles.

tokyo/sento-neighborhoods.keyIdea: Tokyo's public bathhouses now offer shared local spaces, as more people have bathrooms in their own homes.
tokyo/sento-neighborhoods.tradeoff: Bathhouses cannot depend only on washing services when people can wash at home.
tokyo/sento-neighborhoods.designUse: Give older shared facilities new uses while keeping familiar local routines.

seoul/subway-system-video.keyIdea: Seoul's subway uses platform doors and camera inspections to improve safety, while stations also host shops and performances.
seoul/subway-system-video.tradeoff: Safety equipment alone cannot replace ongoing cleaning, inspection, and customer service.
seoul/subway-system-video.designUse: Combine transport safety features with regular checks and welcoming station spaces.

seoul/gyeongbokgung-video.keyIdea: Seoul's Gyeongbokgung combines palace buildings, a guard ceremony, and museum displays to share parts of Korean history.
seoul/gyeongbokgung-video.tradeoff: A short ceremony can show only one part of the palace's past.
seoul/gyeongbokgung-video.designUse: Pair live demonstrations with displays that explain the history behind them.

seoul/korea-history-video.keyIdea: Moving the royal capital to Seoul made the city part of a wider change in Korea's government.
seoul/korea-history-video.tradeoff: A change of capital shifts political activity away from the previous center.
seoul/korea-history-video.designUse: Show how changes in government move important places within a region.

seoul/hallyu-wave.keyIdea: Seoul's entertainment businesses spread Korean culture through training, online sharing, translation, and fans who introduce it to others.
seoul/hallyu-wave.tradeoff: Workers can become vulnerable when demand or technology changes quickly.
seoul/hallyu-wave.designUse: Help audiences discover local culture through translations and active fan communities.

seoul/cheonggyecheon-restoration.keyIdea: Seoul removed road infrastructure to uncover Cheonggyecheon, bringing water and pedestrian space back into the city center.
seoul/cheonggyecheon-restoration.tradeoff: Removing roads can affect drivers, nearby shops, and the public budget.
seoul/cheonggyecheon-restoration.designUse: Replace selected traffic spaces with water routes where people can walk and rest.

seoul/bukchon-hanok.keyIdea: In Bukchon, visiting hours and clear signs help tourists share old streets with people who live there.
seoul/bukchon-hanok.tradeoff: The same narrow streets that attract visitors also bring noise and privacy problems.
seoul/bukchon-hanok.designUse: Guide visitors through heritage areas without disrupting residents' homes and routines.

singapore/urban-design-video.keyIdea: Singapore's public housing puts schools, shops, parks, and transport near homes, making many daily needs easier to reach.
singapore/urban-design-video.tradeoff: Residents receive long leases, but the state still owns the apartments.
singapore/urban-design-video.designUse: Place everyday services near homes and connect them to public transport.

singapore/hawker-culture-video.keyIdea: Singapore's hawker centers bring different food traditions together, with regular customers returning for particular cooks and dishes.
singapore/hawker-culture-video.tradeoff: Hard work and competition can discourage younger people from taking over stalls.
singapore/hawker-culture-video.designUse: Support new cooks in learning dishes from experienced local stallholders.

singapore/changi-jewel-video.keyIdea: Singapore's Jewel airport complex opens indoor gardens to residents as well as travelers, without requiring a flight ticket.
singapore/changi-jewel-video.tradeoff: Crowds can make even short walks through the gardens take longer.
singapore/changi-jewel-video.designUse: Open attractive transport spaces to nearby residents as well as passengers.

singapore/water-security.keyIdea: Singapore uses several water sources, including cleaned used water, to reduce dependence on any single supply.
singapore/water-security.tradeoff: Desalination needs energy and infrastructure, while local water collection requires protected land.
singapore/water-security.designUse: Combine different water supplies and protect the places that collect rain.

singapore/language-policy.keyIdea: Singapore uses English across communities while teaching home languages to keep cultural identity and family connections.
singapore/language-policy.tradeoff: A common working language can weaken home languages and the memories they carry.
singapore/language-policy.designUse: Use a shared service language while keeping room for home languages.

singapore/gardens-by-the-bay.keyIdea: Singapore's Gardens by the Bay brings plants, buildings, and paths together to help visitors notice nature.
singapore/gardens-by-the-bay.tradeoff: Lights, tourist photos, and paid areas can make the garden feel artificial.
singapore/gardens-by-the-bay.designUse: Build green visitor spaces that show different plants and explain their needs.

paris/city-history-video.keyIdea: Paris replaced many medieval streets with wide boulevards, changing how the city looked as it grew.
paris/city-history-video.tradeoff: New roads removed parts of the older street pattern and buildings.
paris/city-history-video.designUse: Explain which older features a street rebuilding project would replace.

paris/cafe-culture-video.keyIdea: Paris cafes give regular customers a place to meet and watch street life beyond their small homes.
paris/cafe-culture-video.tradeoff: Visitors expecting quick service may find the relaxed pace frustrating.
paris/cafe-culture-video.designUse: Make places to sit socially without rushing people through their visit.

paris/louvre-history-video.keyIdea: The Louvre changed from a fortress into a royal home and then a museum, reflecting changing public roles.
paris/louvre-history-video.tradeoff: Reusing the building involved repeated extensions and construction across many generations.
paris/louvre-history-video.designUse: Adapt important buildings for new public roles while showing earlier uses.

paris/seine-world-heritage.keyIdea: The Seine's banks link bridges, old buildings, and walking routes, showing how Paris grew beside the river.
paris/seine-world-heritage.tradeoff: Choosing which places to preserve can leave some groups' stories less visible.
paris/seine-world-heritage.designUse: Connect riverside paths with signs explaining different layers of local history.

paris/cycling-city.keyIdea: Paris adds bike lanes, slower streets, and pedestrian areas to make short journeys easier without a car.
paris/cycling-city.tradeoff: Quieter streets can help residents but inconvenience drivers and delivery workers.
paris/cycling-city.designUse: Balance safer short journeys with practical access for deliveries and businesses.

paris/tourism-pressure.keyIdea: Paris tourism supports jobs and cultural places, but crowds and visitor expectations also disrupt ordinary city life.
paris/tourism-pressure.tradeoff: Crowds and short-term rentals can make neighborhoods harder for residents to live in.
paris/tourism-pressure.designUse: Plan visitor routes around the everyday needs of people living nearby.

london/sightseeing-english-video.keyIdea: London's Tower Bridge opens for large boats, sharing a river crossing between road traffic and water traffic.
london/sightseeing-english-video.tradeoff: Cars must stop while the bridge opens to let a large boat pass.
london/sightseeing-english-video.designUse: Schedule crossing changes so boat access and road delays are clear.

london/tube-engineering-video.keyIdea: London's Underground trains use stopping marks and door controls, and drivers practice accurate stops in a simulator.
london/tube-engineering-video.tradeoff: A train that misses its stopping position cannot simply reverse and open its doors.
london/tube-engineering-video.designUse: Train operators with simulations before they manage precise stops in service.

london/chinatown-restaurant-video.keyIdea: A Chinatown restaurant's closing shows how losing a lease can break lasting ties between workers and regular customers.
london/chinatown-restaurant-video.tradeoff: Popular community businesses can still lose their premises when a lease ends.
london/chinatown-restaurant-video.designUse: Give established food businesses a stable way to keep their premises.

london/thames-barrier.keyIdea: London's Thames Barrier closes to help keep storm tides from pushing floodwater into the city.
london/thames-barrier.tradeoff: Rising seas and extreme weather can change earlier assumptions about protection.
london/thames-barrier.designUse: Plan flood defenses that can adapt when tides and weather change.

london/west-end-theatre.keyIdea: London's West End performances depend on surrounding restaurants, transport, and workers who support audiences before and after shows.
london/west-end-theatre.tradeoff: Live performance can be expensive, limiting who can afford a theatre visit.
london/west-end-theatre.designUse: Coordinate evening performances with nearby food services and journeys home.

london/borough-market.keyIdea: London's Borough Market lets buyers meet sellers and learn about food while shopping in a shared space.
london/borough-market.tradeoff: A public market can be noisier, more crowded, and more expensive than a supermarket.
london/borough-market.designUse: Make food buying social while leaving room for practical everyday shopping.

new-york/ellis-island-video.keyIdea: At New York's Ellis Island, interpreters helped migrants answer questions, while health and legal checks decided entry.
new-york/ellis-island-video.tradeoff: Wealthier passengers avoided the island, while others faced waiting and possible detention.
new-york/ellis-island-video.designUse: Provide language help wherever important checks decide people's access.

new-york/subway-building-video.keyIdea: New York's electric subway linked central areas with outer boroughs, encouraging construction and making travel part of everyday life.
new-york/subway-building-video.tradeoff: Early passengers complained that trains were crowded and did not reach far enough.
new-york/subway-building-video.designUse: Extend busy rail networks toward neighborhoods that still lack useful connections.

new-york/street-vendors-video.keyIdea: New York vendors organized to challenge fines and win translation help in hearings about their tickets.
new-york/street-vendors-video.tradeoff: Large fines for minor breaches can threaten a vendor's ability to stay in business.
new-york/street-vendors-video.designUse: Make enforcement understandable and give small sellers a way to challenge penalties.

new-york/high-line-park.keyIdea: New York turned a former freight railway into the High Line, adding a planted public walkway above the streets.
new-york/high-line-park.tradeoff: A popular new park can raise nearby costs for long-time residents and small businesses.
new-york/high-line-park.designUse: Reuse old transport structures while checking effects on nearby rents.

new-york/skyscraper-zoning.keyIdea: New York's zoning rules control building height and land use because private towers also affect shared streets.
new-york/skyscraper-zoning.tradeoff: Tall buildings add useful space but can block light and crowd sidewalks.
new-york/skyscraper-zoning.designUse: Set building limits around sunlight, street space, and nearby people's needs.

new-york/public-library.keyIdea: New York's public library offers books, learning help, and quiet space without asking people to buy anything.
new-york/public-library.tradeoff: Shared spaces still need clear rules so different people can use them comfortably.
new-york/public-library.designUse: Keep learning places free and offer guidance as well as information.

cairo/ancient-egypt-video.keyIdea: Ancient Egyptians used land measurement around the Nile to build canals and irrigation systems that supported farming.
cairo/ancient-egypt-video.tradeoff: This farming system depended on access to land and water near the Nile.
cairo/ancient-egypt-video.designUse: Measure local land and water before planning routes that supply crops.

cairo/nile-explainer-video.keyIdea: The Nile carried fertile soil to Egyptian fields, but the Aswan High Dam blocks much of that sediment.
cairo/nile-explainer-video.tradeoff: Blocking sediment disrupts the flood and harvest pattern that farming had relied on.
cairo/nile-explainer-video.designUse: Check what useful materials a new river barrier would stop downstream.

cairo/food-tour-video.keyIdea: Cairo entrepreneurs use food tours to bring attention to local dishes and family-run places usually overshadowed by monuments.
cairo/food-tour-video.tradeoff: Tourists often come for history, leaving local cooking with less recognition.
cairo/food-tour-video.designUse: Create food routes that introduce visitors to local cooks and everyday dishes.

cairo/historic-cairo.keyIdea: Historic Cairo survives through both old buildings and living practices, including workshops, markets, and residents' daily routines.
cairo/historic-cairo.tradeoff: Restoration can change rents and businesses while residents still need better services.
cairo/historic-cairo.designUse: Protect crafts and affordable working spaces as well as historic building fronts.

cairo/grand-egyptian-museum.keyIdea: Near Giza, the Grand Egyptian Museum uses light, labels, and visitor routes to help people understand old objects.
cairo/grand-egyptian-museum.tradeoff: Museum stories also involve disagreements about ownership and who gets to explain the past.
cairo/grand-egyptian-museum.designUse: Arrange objects with clear labels while showing who helps interpret their history.

cairo/khan-el-khalili.keyIdea: At Cairo's Khan el-Khalili, bargaining makes buying goods a personal conversation between sellers and visitors.
cairo/khan-el-khalili.tradeoff: Negotiation takes more time than fixed prices and can feel pressuring.
cairo/khan-el-khalili.designUse: Teach respectful ways to ask prices, make offers, and end a purchase.

dubai/airport-history-video.keyIdea: Dubai expanded its airport alongside airlines, linking the city's growth with trade, tourism, and international business.
dubai/airport-history-video.tradeoff: Serving more passengers requires further airport infrastructure and continued expansion.
dubai/airport-history-video.designUse: Connect airport capacity plans with the businesses and services they support.

dubai/metro-route-2020-video.keyIdea: Dubai's Route 2020 extends the metro into new areas and designs stations for transfers to other transport.
dubai/metro-route-2020-video.tradeoff: Reaching new areas required a large project with both elevated and underground sections.
dubai/metro-route-2020-video.designUse: Place transfer points where a rail extension meets other public services.

dubai/dubai-history-video.keyIdea: Dubai invested oil income in ports, an airport, and public services to build businesses beyond oil.
dubai/dubai-history-video.tradeoff: Oil wealth is limited, so the city cannot rely on it forever.
dubai/dubai-history-video.designUse: Use income from one strong industry to develop other useful services.

dubai/clean-energy.keyIdea: Dubai's clean-energy plans face strong demand from cooling buildings, making water, and moving people around the city.
dubai/clean-energy.tradeoff: Solar power also needs storage, grids, investment, and changes in behavior.
dubai/clean-energy.designUse: Match clean-power plans with the energy needs of cooling and water systems.

dubai/museum-of-future.keyIdea: Dubai's Museum of the Future uses stories and displays to help people imagine technologies and problems ahead.
dubai/museum-of-future.tradeoff: Exciting displays may inspire visitors without giving them a clear plan.
dubai/museum-of-future.designUse: Turn future scenarios into questions about actions visitors could take.

dubai/desert-heat-design.keyIdea: Dubai needs shade, covered paths, and good transport links to make outdoor journeys easier in hot weather.
dubai/desert-heat-design.tradeoff: Wide roads and cooling needs can make walking difficult despite impressive buildings.
dubai/desert-heat-design.designUse: Shade walking and waiting places before adding attractive outdoor features.

sydney/harbour-ecology-video.keyIdea: Sydney Harbour's changing water and varied habitats support many species, including ones scientists have not yet recorded.
sydney/harbour-ecology-video.tradeoff: Population growth increases the responsibility to protect habitats still not fully understood.
sydney/harbour-ecology-video.designUse: Study different waterside habitats before deciding how to develop their edges.

sydney/opera-house-history-video.keyIdea: Sydney's Opera House roof design changed when builders found problems with the site, materials, sound, and climate.
sydney/opera-house-history-video.tradeoff: Repeated redesigns increased costs and delayed opening the building to the public.
sydney/opera-house-history-video.designUse: Test a landmark's structure, sound, and weather response before construction.

sydney/city-growth-video.keyIdea: Sydney's protected harbour supported trade and migration, while railways and a bridge connected its growing city and suburbs.
sydney/city-growth-video.tradeoff: The growing city faces high housing costs, traffic, and environmental pressures.
sydney/city-growth-video.designUse: Link a working port with routes that serve growing residential areas.

sydney/gadigal-eora.keyIdea: Sydney's places carry Gadigal and Eora histories that began long before the modern city and its street map.
sydney/gadigal-eora.tradeoff: A brief acknowledgment can become empty without including local knowledge in public learning.
sydney/gadigal-eora.designUse: Include older place names and local knowledge in signs and lessons.

sydney/beach-safety.keyIdea: Sydney's beach flags and lifesavers help people choose safer swimming areas and understand changing sea conditions.
sydney/beach-safety.tradeoff: Water can be stronger than it looks, even where the beach seems inviting.
sydney/beach-safety.designUse: Mark safer swimming areas and make expert advice easy to find.

sydney/ferry-commute.keyIdea: Sydney ferries carry commuters and visitors on the same harbour routes, combining everyday travel with views of the city.
sydney/ferry-commute.tradeoff: Weather, wharf access, capacity, and connections limit how useful a ferry journey is.
sydney/ferry-commute.designUse: Design water services for regular journeys as well as sightseeing passengers.
